summary.text: Randy Wood represents House District 36 (Calhoun, St. Clair and Talladega Counties) in the Alabama House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, he was a Calhoun County commissioner from 1998 to 2002.
It says he graduated from Saks High School and Southern Union College and served six years in the Alabama National Guard.
The profile also states that he owns Wood's Auto Body Shop in Anniston.
